manual_screenshots.title: Manual screenshots
manual_screenshots.subtitle: Static PNGs for the manual — generated with Playwright (usually locally on Windows).
manual_screenshots.intro: After a UI change: npm run build, run capture, commit PNGs. See docs/MANUAL_SCREENSHOTS.md for the full runbook.
workflow_steps: Set MANUAL_CAPTURE_* in .env (same URL as APP_URL, stable tenant IDs/tokens).
Production: git pull — no Chromium needed on shared hosting.
manual_screenshots.workflow_doc: Full runbook for developers and Cursor agents:
manual_screenshots.not_configured: MANUAL_CAPTURE_EMAIL and MANUAL_CAPTURE_PASSWORD are missing in .env.

manual_screenshots.failed: Screenshot run failed. See status below.

translation_sync.title: Translations
translation_sync.subtitle: Pull pending translations (issues, announcements, units, tasks and documents) from the server, translate locally via Ollama, and push them back.
translation_sync.intro: One click: export on the server (approved issues, active announcements/units/documents and tasks with a description), download, Ollama translation with progress, upload and immediate import. On the server, a cron re-processes import files every hour.
translation_sync.setup_hint: Set TRANSLATION_SYNC_ENABLED=true and fill TRANSLATION_SYNC_SSH_* in .env (local). Set QUEUE_CONNECTION=database and run php artisan queue:work in PowerShell (not sync via Apache).
translation_sync.sync_queue_warning: QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync: SSH does not work via Apache. Use database in .env and run php artisan queue:work in PowerShell.
translation_sync.reminder_body: Pending translations (issues, announcements, units, tasks and documents) must run on your laptop via Platform → Translations (Ollama). The server does not translate automatically.
translation_sync.reminder_local: Run translations via Platform → Translations (Ollama) — for example after new content on the server that received translation slots.
translation_sync.reminder_pending: :count translation(s) still waiting on your laptop.
translation_sync.reminder_none: No pending translations on the server.
translation_sync.server_only_message: Translations run on the local computer, not on the internet server.
translation_sync.not_enabled: TRANSLATION_SYNC_ENABLED is off or SSH settings are missing.
translation_sync.not_configured: TRANSLATION_SYNC_SSH_HOST, SSH_USER or REMOTE_PATH is missing in .env.
translation_sync.already_running: A translation run is already in progress.
translation_sync.failed: Translation run failed. See status below.
translation_sync.completed_summary: :imported of :total translations imported on the server.
translation_sync.nothing_pending: No pending translations on the server.
translation_sync.stalled: The translation run appears stuck (no recent updates). Check that php artisan queue:work is still running in PowerShell. SSH/SCP may hang after translating.
translation_sync.reset_stuck_done: Status cleared. Start again if queue:work is still running.
translation_sync.reset_stuck_cancelling: Status cleared. Close queue:work in PowerShell with Ctrl+C if it is still running, then start again.
translation_sync.stop_confirm: Are you sure you want to stop the running translation sync?
translation_sync.stop_requested: Stop requested — waiting for the current step to finish.
translation_sync.cancelling_hint: The worker stops once the current step finishes (SSH may take a while). Taking too long? Clear status and close queue:work in PowerShell with Ctrl+C.
translation_sync.nothing_to_cancel: No translation run is in progress to stop.
translation_sync.cancelled_note: The translation run was stopped. Nothing was imported on the server.
